verdict.rationale: Paddle has robust first-party webhook documentation covering event push, signature verification, and a dedicated 'paddle-webhooks' agent skill discoverable via the well-known skills index, plus MCP tooling to 'configure webhooks and simulate events for testing' — directly enabling AI-native agents to subscribe to and work with webhook events. missing for 10: no independent/community hands-on confirmation of an agent actually subscribing via webhooks end-to-end, and no evidence of a push-based agent notification channel beyond the documented skill/MCP simulate-and-configure flow.
